scope: Selected native messaging-client sound files, not an exhaustive inventory and not a claim that every file is the first-ever encoding of its sound.
byteIdentity: SHA-256 of the complete extracted WAV, including RIFF headers, padding and metadata. No conversion, trimming, normalization or re-encoding.

packages.retrieval: Normal Download for Windows form; download saved without execution.
packages.authenticode: No verifiable Authenticode signature; 16-bit NE installer. Internal Wise script says 1.02 Beta; extracted ICQ.exe includes Beta 1.02, Mirabilis LTD product metadata, and PE timestamp 1996-12-09T12:52:32Z. These are internal corroboration, not independent proof of release date or an unbroken vendor chain of custody.
packages.extraction: E_WISE_W.EXE from the author's e_wise.arj extracts payloads without executing the ICQ installer; 00000000.TXT maps 00000032.EWI to %MAINDIR%\Sounds\Message.wav.
packages.dateLabel: 1996 / ICQ 1.02 Beta; December 9 is the embedded executable build timestamp, not an independently established release date.

crossVersionMatch.result: Message.wav is byte-identical to the 9996-byte ICQ 1.02 Beta file. This corroborates the sound across separately retrieved releases, but both could descend from the same preservation lineage; no independent vendor signature is claimed.

authenticode.checkMethod: Windows Get-AuthenticodeSignature on the exact downloaded installer, 2026-09-04

packages.extraction: 7-Zip 23.01 parses the PE resource .rsrc/RCDATA/CABINET (239071 bytes, LZX:21) and extracts type.wav, online.wav and newemail.wav without executing the installer. msmsgs.inf explicitly maps these to New Message, Contact Online and New Mail.
packages.dateLabel: 22 July 1999 service launch; binary version 1.0.0863. Embedded application build timestamp July 17 1999; sound members carry December 4 1998 timestamps. Those timestamps are not sound-composition dates.

crossVersionMatch.result: All three WAVs byte-identical to build 1.0.0863.

authenticode.timeStamper: VeriSign Time Stamping Service CA SW1
authenticode.checkMethod: Windows Get-AuthenticodeSignature on the exact downloaded installer, 2026-09-04

packages.extraction: The signed outer executable embeds a Wise PE starting at byte offset 4076. Copy the byte suffix from offset 4076 to a scratch file; WiseUnpacker 3.0.0 extracts its payload without executing AIM. Extracted aim.exe has ProductVersion/FileVersion 4.1.2010 and America Online, Inc. metadata; WiseScript.bin contains the original %MAINDIR%/Sounds paths.
packages.dateLabel: 2000 / AIM 4.1.2010. Embedded application PE build timestamp 2000-06-09T21:26:36Z. Do not label these as proven 1997 launch bytes.
packages.earlierComparison: AIM 1.0.386 installer was downloaded but its older InstallShield self-extractor has not been decoded. No claim about matching the earliest AIM release is made.
